hook_proposals.text: Did an AI screening algorithm just rank your job application? Here is how recruiters use AI filtering in 2026.
Stuffing white text keywords into your resume won't trick modern AI recruiters. In fact, it flags your profile instantly.
Over 68% of enterprise hiring teams now use automated semantic scoring before scheduling a single 15-minute phone screen.
If you want your resume to score at the top of AI recruitment filters, format your achievements with measurable context.

script_beats.hook_0_3s: Did an AI screening algorithm just rank your job application? Here is how recruiters use AI filtering in 2026.
script_beats.problem_3_10s: Most candidates assume that getting rejected means they weren't qualified. But in reality, their profile broke during automated intake.
script_beats.insight_10_35s: Show on screen the ATS parsing view vs human PDF view. Highlight how custom icons, multi-column tables, and missing keywords scramble the extracted candidate profile.
script_beats.solution_35_50s: Use standard single-column layouts, clean chronological headings (Experience, Education, Skills), and mirror the exact phrasing from the target job description.
script_beats.cta_50_60s: Save this breakdown for your next job application, and check your resume compatibility free on TalentXcel.
